or special key processing. Returns the stream.

As of v5.2.2, `true` sets `constants.mode.RAW_VT` rather than `constants.mode.RAW`. On Windows, `RAW_VT` has the console deliver virtual terminal sequences, so keys that libuv's own translation of console input leaves out reach the stream, such as Shift+Tab (`\x1b[Z`). On other platforms it behaves like `RAW`.
